pronunciation: per · tik · yoo · LARR · ih · tee
definition: A special quality of attention given to one person or thing.
author: Jane Austen
quote: In that house Elizabeth must be first; and she was in the habit of such general observance as “Miss Elliot,” that any particularity of attention seemed almost impossible.
example_sentence: She described the dress with loving particularity.
